scope: Partial G1 acceptance for isolated Python toolchain resolution, PostgreSQL 18.1 migration schema, migration CLI, and database role/privilege checks only. This does not accept G2-G7, all of B02, or AT-21/other original acceptance cases.

checks: Verified the published archive digest and its exact three-entry inventory, entry byte counts, and SHA256 values against the verification report.
Verified the archived gate bytes equal the frozen raw gate digest, with 12 passed cases, zero failures/errors/skips, empty source_changes, and matching candidate fingerprint.

Recomputed all 32 frozen source hashes against the current worktree; all matched. Independently rechecked the original 17 imported design files and two uploaded source files against source-manifest.json.

Compared the original local JUnit XML with the published XML after removing only the hostname attribute: the XML trees are otherwise equal, including all 12 test cases, durations, counts, and outcomes. The public archive has redacted-local-host and contains no original machine hostname.
Verified the archive excludes private-lifecycle.json and raw PostgreSQL server logs. The included pytest log is only the successful dot summary and aggregate count.

Runtime and operator roles are shared application roles; this G1 migration check does not establish per-user database isolation or RLS. The operator catalog insertion privilege still depends on the later G2 Node bridge import validation boundary.
Original AT-21 and all original acceptance cases remain not executed. Full Node/build/browser regression G6 remains pending.
The earlier failed targeted-test output files were not retained; the TC ledger records their classifications, and no historical log was reconstructed or represented as a passing gate artifact.
workspace_review: The current worktree changes are confined to the documented G1 Python/migration/toolchain files, G1 tests/evidence, README/.gitignore, and progress metadata. Original ZIP/DOCX uploads remain untracked and outside the acceptance archive; no Paperclip database or auth files appear among changed paths.
reviewer_verdict: Accept the frozen G1 candidate as a partial B02 foundation. Keep the G2-G7, B02, AT-21, production identity/database, and original acceptance work explicitly pending.
